name: WikiKG90Mv2: Large-Scale Knowledge Graph Completion
description: WikiKG90Mv2 is a massive knowledge graph benchmark from the OGB Large-Scale Challenge (OGB-LSC), extracted from a complete dump of Wikidata. Containing 91,230,610 entities, 1,387 relations, and 601,062,811 factual triplets, it is an order of magnitude larger than previous knowledge graph benchmarks. The task is link prediction (predicting head or tail entities for triplets), evaluated by Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) across diverse domain facts.
